selection_rationale: PR-AUC leader is random_forest_balanced at 0.7992 (95% CI 0.7132-0.8750)

Paired bootstrap: 6 candidates are statistically indistinguishable from the leader (difference CI contains zero): random_forest_balanced, histgb_smote_0.01, histgb_undersample_0.05, histgb_smote_0.05, histgb_adasyn_0.05, logistic_regression_balanced
Tie broken on calibration (Brier), because the operating threshold is chosen from a cost model that requires trustworthy probabilities.
histgb_smote_0.05 has the lowest Brier at 0.000444 (vs 0.002730 for the PR-AUC leader) — a 6.1x improvement in probability quality at no significant PR-AUC cost.
